Hey, Tomás here. Team's staying for the launch-review dinner — one group DoorDash cart, company budget, assistants driving. You're up for mine. I'm in the all-hands til 7 and then straight into a client call, so it's your show. Oh and Priya (office mgmt) asked us to pass along: the meal benefit is strictly per-person tonight — no splitting plates, benefit accounting thing. If anything needs a call mid-run, make it — don't wait on me.

One more thing from Priya: the courier desk stops taking orders about 21 minutes from now, so whatever we land on has to be in the cart and submitted by then.
Nothing further from me for now.
[text from Tomás] Peeked at my phone in the all-hands and saw the order ping — how'd dinner shake out? What's coming for me?
